newsitem.title: UK: UK Treasury says data show exports performing well.
newsitem.headline: UK Treasury says data show exports performing well.

text.p: The British Treasury said on Wednesday latest trade data showed exports were performing well.
"As the Chancellor said in his speech yesterday, exports are performing very well. The latest data confirm this," a Treasury official said.

In October, Britain recorded a non-European Union trade deficit of 424 million stg, compared with a gap of 805 million stg in September. The October figure was below market expectations for a deficit of 800 million stg.
Britain had a global trade deficit of 899 million stg in September, against 568 million stg in August and compared with forecasts for a one billion stg shortfall in September.
